messages:
kevin: Heads up — after the driver/kernel roll on west-gpu this morning (driver 545.23 / kernel 6.6) some mixed-sku nodes are not advertising NVLink. NCCL falls back to NET and jobs see ~3x throughput regression. Anyone seen similar?

maria: seeing same on a few hosts. A100/H100 mixes mostly. Some nodes report full NVLink in `nvidia-smi topo -m`, others show P2P as 'PHB' + missing NVLink entries.

kevin: sample outputs from two nodes:
```
# node-good: nvidia-smi topo -m
GPU0  GPU1  CPU Affinity
GPU0    X    NVLINK
GPU1  NVLINK   X

# node-bad: nvidia-smi topo -m
GPU0  GPU1  CPU Affinity
GPU0    X    PHB
GPU1    PHB   X
```

jon: interesting. is this visible in lspci topology / nvlink sysfs? can you paste `dmesg | grep -i nvlink` and `lsmod | grep nvidia`?

maria: dmesg has repeated lines like:
```
[  123.456] nvlink: link 1 partner not responding, disabling
[  123.456] nvlink: port 1 training failed
```
lsmod shows nvidia, nvidia_uvm, nvidia_drm loaded on both nodes.

sre-jen: we hit something like this in a prior rollout when IOMMU flags and a kernel change caused the driver to skip NVLink training on mixed PCIe topologies. Did the kernel change include any PCIe or IOMMU patches?

kevin: kernel 6.6 included a backported PCIe change that touched upstream PCI topology handling. Rollout notes mention IOMMU config tweak for a subset of regions.

devin: quick checks: run `nvidia-smi -q | grep -i nvlink` and check `/sys/kernel/debug/nvlink/*/link_state`. Also try `nvidia-smi topo -m` right after a cold boot vs after live driver bind. If training fails only after live update, there may be a missing rebind step.

maria: did `nvidia-smi -q` on bad node shows NVLink sections present but state=DOWN. `/sys/kernel/debug/nvlink/*/training` shows 'failed' on port 1.

ops-bot: NOTE: detected increased NET fallback for NCCL in pool west-gpu-large-1 between 07:00-09:30 UTC. Impact: estimated 42% capacity loss for distributed TF jobs.

jon: can we reproduce with a simple NCCL P2P test? `MPI/NCCL` bandwidth tests will show SHM vs SOCKET fallbacks. If SHM also failing, it's likely local kernel/driver interplay.

kevin: ran `nccl-tests` on a bad node — shows sockets only, SHM not used, throughput matches NET numbers.

sre-jen: mitigation options: 1) roll back kernel to 6.5 for affected subpool, 2) force nodes to reboot (cold boot) which sometimes retrains NVLink successfully, 3) hold driver and re-run a careful staged kernel roll with QA nodes first.

devin: try probing `modprobe -r nvidia_uvm; modprobe nvidia_uvm` and re-run `nvidia-smi topo -m`. In one case reloading uvm triggered retrain. But warm rebind may be unreliable on mixed-sku hosts.

maria: attempted uvm reload and soft GPU reset with `nvidia-smi --gpu-reset -i 0` — no dice on a few nodes; only full reboot fixed NVLink training on those.

jon: what about BIOS/firmware mismatch? We saw NVLink negotiation issues on a rack with older NVBIOS on some A100s. Any firmware diffs?

kevin: firmware versions diverge on a subset (some older A100s have pre-2023 NVBIOS). We didn't touch firmware during the roll, but the driver + kernel change could expose firmware timing edge cases.

sre-jen: action plan suggestion:
- Quarantine affected nodes (taint) to stop scheduling distributed jobs.
- Run a small canary: cold reboot one problematic host, verify NVLink via `nvidia-smi topo -m` and `nccl-tests`.
- If cold reboot fixes, schedule rolling reboots with maintenance windows; if not, rollback kernel in pool and open driver/kernel ticket with vendor.

kevin: agreed. I'll tag `west-gpu-large-1` and `west-gpu-burst-2` as impacted and cordon/taint. Starting cold reboot canary now (node id: west-gpu-23). Will report results.

maria: can someone own firmware inventory check across pool? If we find mixed NVBIOS, we should postpone next roll until we standardize or vendor advises.

devin: I'll script a quick `/sbin/flash_nvbios --query` (actually we'll pull via `nvidia-smi -q` + vendor tool) across the zone and post summary in this thread by EOD.

ops-bot: OUTAGE WARNING: Scheduled reboots may impact running jobs. Please coordinate with SRE and notify customers in affected tenants.

kevin: can everyone add any failing node IDs they see to the thread. I'll compile and update the incident ticket. Thanks :thumbsup:

maria: added node ids west-gpu-23, west-gpu-29, west-gpu-31.

jon: noted. If we need quick capacity, promote warm spare pool in east region to handle critical distributed training until west pool is recovered.

sre-jen: creating runbook checklist and will paste it here once done. We'll decide rollback vs reboot after canary result.

kevin: canary cold reboot completed: NVLink trained successfully on west-gpu-23, nccl-tests show SHM + NVLink bandwidth back to expected. Will schedule rolling reboots in maintenance windows and hold further kernel rolls in west.

devin: posted firmware inventory gist (internal link) — several older A100s flagged. Adding firmware upgrade as follow-up item.

kevin: thanks team. Follow-ups: schedule reboot plan + customer comms + firmware ticket with vendor. Closing investigation thread for now, will update when reboots start.
